Hyderabad, Telangana

Professional Summary
Productive Go developer and platform engineer with experience building and operating microservices-based systems, focusing on observability and high-throughput messaging. Proven track record delivering backend services, improving system reliability, and collaborating in Agile teams. Open to relocation anywhere in India. Notice period: 60 days.

Technical Skills
Go, gRPC, Microservices, Docker, Apache Kafka, Redis, Prometheus, Linux, Confluence, Agile

Work Experience

Go Developer, UrbanPantry (May 2023 - Apr 2026)
- Implemented core order-processing microservices in Go using gRPC for low-latency inter-service communication, reducing RPC round-trip time by ~40% on critical paths.
- Containerized services with Docker and optimized startup and memory usage to support bursty traffic during peak hours; improved deployment density by 30%.
- Integrated Prometheus instrumentation across services to expose custom metrics and created alerting rules that lowered mean time to detection for service degradations by 25%.
- Built Kafka producers/consumers and Redis caching layers to handle high-throughput events and reduce database load, enabling 2x sustained order ingestion during promotions.

Platform Engineer, Freshworks (May 2022 - Apr 2023)
- Designed and maintained platform microservices and shared libraries in Go to standardize service templates and streamline new service onboarding across teams.
- Implemented Prometheus-based monitoring dashboards and alerts for platform services, increasing SLA adherence and visibility for incident response.
- Automated container builds and deployments with Docker workflows and Linux-based CI runners, reducing lead time for changes and deployment errors.
- Collaborated in Agile sprints, documented runbooks and architecture notes in Confluence, and integrated Kafka and Redis components for event-driven platform features.

Education
MBA (Marketing), IIM Indore
